description: Historical observations, not a promise. Includes failed/retried CI. Total task rework may take longer. Re-measure after execution changes.

observations.note: First scoped Linux measurement: Node typecheck and 21 actual JPEG/resource-boundary tests passed. Candidate and main each ran the small Node job and the iOS selector only; no Mac jobs or TestFlight. Candidate-commit elapsed starts at product 128e2b2 and includes CI-path implementation/review, not just final green run. Local real-adapter six checks are separate evidence, not live D1/R2 or deployed preservation. Not a general duration guarantee.

Build, Photos, both-OS runtime and disabled preservation UI passed. Window album UI failed on a real accessibility wrapper issue. Not a successful candidate; followed by the same-operation diagnostic, not a blind normal retry.

Initial 30-minute plan missed; explicitly revised to a 60-minute cumulative planning reference before the focused diagnostic. Same fixed candidate SHA passed the diagnostic and required normal build/Photos/both-OS runtime/two UI cases. Native screenshots inspected. Main reused same-SHA evidence without Mac jobs. No TestFlight upload, production storage activation or actual account/device restore claim.

Candidate alone passed first attempt. Main evidence reuse failed twice without logged reason; duplicate first attempt stopped, second attempt all checks completed. Whole delivery did not meet 30-minute goal.
Stopped remaining duplicate builds after a SwiftUI type-check failure before UI execution. This is not successful full-scope timing.

Includes failed Gallery app.launch background-assertion timeout and only that job retry; successful sibling jobs were reused. Main skipped Mac jobs using same-SHA evidence. No TestFlight in this batch; total did not meet 30-minute goal.

First attempt passed: build/privacy, Photos bootstrap+scan, both-OS runtime and 3 affected UI methods. Widget Gallery inputs were unchanged and excluded by frozen full-diff manifest. Separate server CI passed. Main reused same-SHA evidence in 19 seconds. Candidate commit to Apple upload exceeded 30 minutes by 85 seconds; no retry, no real-device or sales activation claim.
Early project load failure from duplicate PBX identities; not successful full-scope timing. Added existing foundation duplicate check.
Compile failure from UUID? return type compared with String; corrected existing validator use.

Build, Photos and runtime succeeded; requester UI passed. Owner confirmation failed only because a native parent/child AX wrapper matched twice. Narrow diagnostic required before next ordinary candidate.

All four required jobs and both UI operations succeeded after focused diagnostic. No change to beta limits, no real service deployment or StoreKit claim. Original 30-minute and intermediate 45-minute objectives missed; total includes two implementation mistakes and one test-selector correction, not just final candidate duration.

All Build, Photos and sharing-runtime checks succeeded. Both export UI operations reached the system share sheet but failed waiting for the application-owned accessibility marker. Native artifact review found ShareSheet.RemoteContainerView and header.closeButton for both ZIP exports. This is a failed observation, not completed source-retention/cancellation evidence; a focused diagnostic of both methods is required before the next ordinary candidate.

Both private export cancellation paths and all four mandatory jobs passed. Initial UI failure was an application-owned identifier absent from the native remote share sheet; only the two test selectors were corrected. Original 35-minute plan missed. Production source was unchanged after the first candidate; real cross-device restore and shared-record bundle export remain outside this result.
